name: Glass funnel
oneLiner: 3 or 4 stacked glass funnel stages build top to bottom, a pulse of light drops through them while each number counts down from the stage above, and the conversion rate stamps out of the spout
say: when the speaker walks through how many people make it from one step to the next (visitors, sign-ups, customers): the pulse drops on each step as it is named, the stamp lands on the final rate
